Hello,

You’re setting up multi-factor authentication (MFA) for your SELISE Blocks account. Enter the verification code below to complete the setup.

Verification code

{{TwoFactorCode}}

This code will expire shortly. If it expires, you can request a new one from SELISE Blocks.

If you did not try to enable MFA on your account, do not use this code and contact our support team.

For your security, never share this verification code with anyone. SELISE will never ask you for this code by email, phone, or chat.

Need help?
appsupport@selisegroup.com

SELISE Group AG
